t.PHENOXYETHANOL.agn: In the EU it may be used as a preservative at up to 1% (Annex V, entry 29). In 2016 the SCCS found this limit safe for consumers of all ages.
t.PHENOXYETHANOL.eff.0: According to the SCCS, safe at the 1% limit for consumers of all ages, including children; there is no official warning of side effects for this use.
t.PHENOXYETHANOL.reg.0: EU Cosmetics Regulation Annex V, entry 29: Permitted preservative, with an upper limit.
t.PHENOXYETHANOL.summary: One of the most common preservatives in cosmetics.
t.PHENOXYETHANOL.what: Prevents bacteria and fungi from growing in water-based products, so the product does not spoil.
